function.name: modify_sap_object
function.description: Modify the source code of an EXISTING SAP object - including REMOVING a PART of it. Use this tool whenever the user wants to add, change, refactor, or DELETE something INSIDE an object: a FORM/subroutine, a method, a block of code, header comments, lines, a variable, etc. 'delete/remove/clear the form X', 'remove the comments', 'delete method M' are all modifications handled here (NOT delete_sap_object, which erases the whole program/class). The object must have been read with read_sap_object first. The result is wrapped in a <code_modified> envelope and saved after user confirmation. Do NOT use for examples the user does not want saved - use show_code_example instead.

object_type.description: Type of SAP object to modify. For method signature changes use CLAS, not METH.

object_name.description: Technical name, e.g. 'ZCL_TEST'. For signature changes the class name only, not CLASS=>METHOD.

action_description.description: Precise description of the change to perform
